newsitem.title: USA: TSR shares soar on CATCH/21 test results.
newsitem.headline: TSR shares soar on CATCH/21 test results.

text.p: TSR Inc said its Year 2000 conversion software, CATCH/21, completed a satisfactory field test of an 80,000 line COBOL application for a Fortune 500 company.

TSR shares jumped as much as 48 percent on the news to 40 before settling to close at 37-1/2. up 10-1/2 on volulme of about 913,000 shares, compared with their year-to-date average volume of about 46,000 shares.
TSR declined to identify the Fortune 500 company. Joseph Hughes, TSR's Chairman, would not comment beyond what the company included in its press release, he said.

TSR said in its press release that the unidentified Fortune 500 company still has not confirmed TSR's conclusion of the test results. TRS said it expects a decision from the company during the next few weeks.

If the decision is favorable, TSR said it will receive "a small amount of revenue." The company also said it anticipates "being in a favorable position to receive orders for additional Year 2000 work from this organization."
The shares' move today follows their rise yesterday of six points to 27. Prior to that, the shares had risen 10-3/8 their last seven trading sessions, according to Investor's Business Daily.

The paper also reported on Friday that TSR said SOES bandits were pushing up the price of its stock by cornering it on the Nasdaq's Small Order Execution System and selling it to market makers at a premium.
TSR's CATCH/21 is software aimed at upgrading computer systems to tabulate dates after the year 1999.
